name: Galich-Manturovo-Sharya Gas Pipeline Branch (Kostroma Oblast)

values.RouteNotes: No route drawn; only a 15.4 km OSM fragment (Gryazovets-Buy-Galich-Sharya) exists. Stage chainage: GRS Galich km 0, Parfenyevo 55.3, Neya 81.6, Manturovo 139.3, Sharya 182.1. Continuation of the built DN500 Buy-Galich branch (unverified).

researcher_notes: NEW ROW, ONE ROW (whole branch), Status construction. Not matched to any existing row: GGIT 20260930 snapshot has no Galich/Neya/Manturovo/Sharya endpoint and no Kostroma-Oblast row of this name (Kostroma rows are only the Gryazovets-* trunks, which do not touch Galich-Sharya). Threshold: sponsor = Gazprom PJSC (customer Gazprom Invest, general contractor Gazstroyproekt, designer Gazprom proektirovanie; Neftegaz.ru 2020 'Gazprom realizes the project'); endpoints GRS Galich (km 0) to GRS Sharya (km 182.1), Kostroma Oblast; concrete step = construction since 2011, paused 2013, resumed 2020, three of four stages already carrying gas; length 182.1 km sourced by three lineages (Neftegaz.ru 2020 roadmap article, Neftegazpro stage chainage page, contractor Gazstroyproekt project list). Operating/partly built line GEM never captured, so inside the window. ONE ROW OR PER-STAGE: stage lengths per Neftegaz.ru 2020: I Galich-Parfenyevo 55.3, II Parfenyevo-Neya 26.3, III Neya-Manturovo 57.7, IV Manturovo-Sharya 42.8 km (sum 182.1; Neftegazpro chainage km 0/55.3/81.6/139.3/182.1 agrees). Status by stage: I gas to Parfenyevo 2021 (Neftegaz.ru Dec 2023), II/III gas to Neya and Manturovo GRS Dec 2023 (Minenergo, Neftegaz.ru and Energyland, two publishers), IV Manturovo-Sharya (42.8 km) NOT complete: due 3Q 2024 per Dec 2023 statement, then K1news 2026-07-24 (Kostroma governor review) says gas launch at GRS Sharya is planned by end of 2026. So 139.3 km (stages I-III) is operating and 42.8 km (stage IV) is under construction. Staged as ONE row for the whole 182.1 km at Status=construction because the shard format is single-row and the branch is one Gazprom project not yet complete; RECOMMEND the consolidator/Baird split into two segments instead if GEM convention prefers per-segment status: Galich-Neya-Manturovo 139.3 km operating (ConstructionYear 2011, StartYear 2021 for the Parfenyevo stage / 2023 for Neya and Manturovo) and Manturovo-Sharya 42.8 km construction (StartYear1 2026, slipped from 2022 then 3Q 2024). Stage IV status itself rests on one 2026 regional source (K1news) plus the absence of any Sharya launch report; no search turned up a Sharya GRS commissioning. Values: Capacity 570 mcm/y = 0.57 bcm/y (Minenergo-sourced Neftegaz.ru Dec 2023 and Neftegazpro, unit conversion only; one search snippet gave 487 mcm/y, not on any page I could verify, ignored). Cost 7.4 bn RUB project budget (Neftegazpro; 1.7 bn RUB spent in 2020 alone). Stage-start years vary by source (Neftegazpro generic page says construction began 2017, Neftegaz.ru says 2011; used 2011, the two-source dated statement from the Minenergo trip story). ProposalYear blank (Neftegaz.ru says Gazprom implementing since 2012; no proposal source). Owner: Gazprom PJSC (existing entity 'Gazprom PJSC' via entity_lookup; Gazprom Invest is customer/developer, not separate owner).
